units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:8:11">Y. Ber. II, 5ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>קשה היא הל׳ שתחילתה וכ׳</he> (not <he>הליצניות</he>) scoffing is a serious thing, for its beginning brings suffering, and its end destruction.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:3:2">Cant. R. to I, 3</cite> <he>דברי ל׳</he> frivolous speech, v. <cite ref="G00689"><he>זִרְזֵיף</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:3:2">Ib.</cite> <he>אם נכנס … דבר של ל׳</he> when a word of the Law (a religious thought) enters the heart, a word of scoffing is removed &c.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7:4">Num. R. s. 7</cite>; a. e.
